symptom: External execution continuity was demonstrated, but preservation of objective, rules, pending work and closure criteria across conversational interruption had not yet been independently tested.
root_cause: The earlier recovery conclusion conflated external execution continuity with continuity of the full task state.
early_signals: The external workflow succeeded after the conversational stream timed out
No explicit continuity checkpoint comparison had yet been executed
human_cost: Risk of premature closure, duplicated work, lost restrictions or plausible-but-unfaithful narrative reconstruction.
prevention_rule: Persist a resumable checkpoint and validate recovered objective, scope, rule set, pending work, evidence and closure contract before continuing after interruption.
automated_detection: MOCATRIZ Continuity Test 02 scores ten dimensions and applies nullifying failures plus checkpoint comparison.
